description:
Returns information on the authenticated user. If a company_id or project_id parameter is included, directory-specific information  on the user will also be returned. Returns a globally unique user id  (across companies).
NOTE: This endpoint does not require the ['Procore-Company-Id' header] (https://developers.procore.com/documentation/tutorial-mpz) to be included on a request unless a company_id or project_id parameter  is also included.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company. You must supply either a company_id or project_id in order for a name to be returned.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project. You must supply either a company_id or project_id in order for a name to be returned.

parameters.name: owners_company_id
parameters.description: ID of the owners company used to return the owners user profile.

id.description: Unique identifier for the authenticated user.

login.description: The email address that the user uses to log into Procore.

first_name.description: Given name of the owners user. Included when owners_company_id matches an owners user.

last_name.description: Family name of the owners user. Included when owners_company_id matches an owners user.

owners_user_id.description: ID of the user in the owners company. Included when owners_company_id matches an owners user.
